SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, (A.FOLDERNO || '-' || A.MONITORPOINTNAME) AS FOLDERNAME, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.TESTORGID, B.STATUS PROJECTSTATUS, B.CREATEDBYNAME AS PROJECTCREATEDBYNAME, B.ENTRUSTORGNAME, B.BIZCATEGORYID, B.BIZCATEGORYCODE, B.URGENT,B.ORGID,B.ORGNAME, D.AREANAME FROM T_EMC_FOLDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CLIENT C ON B.ENTRUSTORGID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_AREA D ON C.AREAID = D.ID) T
AND T.ORGID like CONCAT(#{orgId}, '%')
AND (T.RUNID IS NULL OR T.RUNID ='')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = ''))
AND (INSTR( ',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR INSTR(',' || SCENEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sceneUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR INSTR(',' || PLANSAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0)
AND INSTR(',' || SCENEUSERID || ',', ',' || #{sceneUserId} || ',' ) > 0
AND (INSTR(',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',') > 0 OR INSTR(',' || PLANSAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 )
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = '')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_SAMPLE S LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER M ON S.ID = M.SAMPLEID WHERE M.FOLDERID = T.ID AND S.STATUS = 'draft' AND S.CREATEDBYID = #{loginUser.id}))
AND (INSTR( ',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR INSTR(',' || SCENEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sceneUserId} || ',' ) > 0 OR INSTR(',' || PLANSAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0)
AND INSTR(',' || SCENEUSERID || ',', ',' || #{sceneUserId} || ',' ) > 0
AND (INSTR(',' || SAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',') > 0 OR INSTR(',' || PLANSAMPLEUSERID || ',',',' || #{sampleUserId} || ',' ) > 0 )
ORDER BY
T.FOLDERNO, T.ID DESC
